name: dlead-sbi-feedback-prep
description: Builds an SBI Feedback Prep Sheet from the lead's own notes, with the situation, the observable behaviour and the impact, labels turned back into observations, the intent question to ask and what the lead wants to happen next. Use for "run dlead-sbi-feedback-prep", "SBI feedback", "situation behaviour impact", "how do I give hard feedback to a designer", "prepare a feedback conversation", "my feedback comes out vague", "feedback for a senior designer", part of the Claude for Design Leaders Pack by 90n.
